title: fix(app-shell,plugin-detail,i18n): the assistant FAB yields its corner to the inline-edit Save and attachment row actions, and attachment delete asks first (objectui#12248)
body:
Fixes #12248
Clause-②: yes

Item 2 of objectui#12211, split out per triage comment 6121957396. Two record-page defects, measured on a hosted console (HotCRM 4.0.1, zh-CN) and re-measured on this tree.

## What changes

**1. The assistant button yields its corner.** `ConsoleChatbotFab` is fixed at the bottom-right of every page (`bottom-6 right-6`, 56px). That corner is where the record page's sticky inline-edit bar puts Save. It is also where the last attachment row's Delete lands at full scroll, when the attachments panel is the page's last content. A click there opened the assistant.

- `ConsoleChatbotFab` now goes `invisible` while an element carrying `data-fab-yield` overlaps its own box: not seen, not hit-testable, out of the tab order. It comes back as soon as the corner is free. It re-measures at most once per frame: on any scroll (captured, so the record page's own scroller counts), on resize, and when nodes are added or removed.
- `InlineEditSaveBar` (`@object-ui/plugin-detail`) marks its bar with `data-fab-yield`. `RecordAttachmentsPanel` marks its Download and Delete row actions.
- **Positional, not presence.** Under `sm` the FAB sits at `bottom-20`, above the bar, so on a phone it stays (measured below).
- **Opt-in, not "any control".** A list scrolling row actions through the corner would otherwise make the FAB blink on every list page.
- The assistant stays reachable from the top bar and with Cmd/Ctrl+Shift+I.
- There is no new setting, no prop on a published component, no export and no spec key. The marker is a DOM attribute, and the two packages share no symbol for it.

**2. Attachment delete asks first.** `RecordAttachmentsPanel` called `dataSource.delete('sys_attachment', id)` in the click handler. It now asks through `ActionConfirmDialog`, painted destructive. The dialog is mounted with the same promise-based state as the record page's own Delete (objectui#11001). `ActionConfirmDialog.tsx` is unchanged.

- **Title:** the existing `detail.deleteAttachment` ("Delete attachment" / 删除附件), which names the attachment.
- **Question:** a new key, `detail.deleteAttachmentConfirm`, which interpolates the file name. It is in all ten packs, with real translations. No existing key says "delete this attachment": `detail.deleteConfirmation` and `objectActions.deleteConfirm` both say "this record".
- **Confirm button:** the existing `objectActions.deleteConfirmButton` ("Delete" / 删除), the one the record delete uses. It names no noun.
- **Cancel** sends nothing.

## Why this mechanism

These alternatives were weighed against the measured geometry and dropped:

- **A CSS `:has()` presence rule** (the FAB hides while a save bar exists). It covers Save. But it would also hide the FAB on phones, where the bar never reaches it, and it cannot see a row action at full scroll.
- **Bottom clearance on the record page's scroller.** This is the root-cause shape for "the last content cannot scroll clear of a fixed button". But `RecordDetailView.tsx` is outside this card's claimed file surface, and the change would move every record page's bottom spacing.
- **Extra padding on the panel's last row.** This couples the panel's spacing to the FAB everywhere the panel renders, including the synthesized Attachments tab.
- **A positional check against any button under the FAB.** This would hide the FAB on list pages whenever rows scroll through the corner.

## Measurements

**Method.** Playwright drove Chromium against a dev-only harness: the real `RecordDetailView` inside the real `AppShell` with the console's main-area classes, a stub data source, and the real `ConsoleChatbotFab`. The harness was served by the console's own Vite config, so it had the console stylesheet. The attachments case uses an authored record page that omits `record:attachments`, so `RecordDetailView` appends the panel at the bottom of its scroller, which is the hosted shape. The harness was a temporary untracked entry and was deleted before commit.

Boxes are (x, y, width, height) in CSS px. "Hit" is `document.elementFromPoint` at the control's centre.

**Before.** Save was measured on the base code. The attachments Delete was measured with the panel's two markers removed through `ablation-replace.mjs` (restore proven), which is the pre-fix behaviour for that row.

| Viewport | Control | Control box | FAB box | Hit |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| 1440×900 zh | Save | 1327.3, 831, 75.7, 36 (centre 1365.2, 849) | 1360, 820, 56, 56 | 打开HotCRM助手. A click there opened the assistant. |
| 1440×1400 zh | Save | 1327.3, 1331, 75.7, 36 | 1360, 1320, 56, 56 | 打开HotCRM助手 |
| 1280×720 and 1920×1080, en and zh | Save | right end under the FAB | | the FAB |
| 1440×900 zh | Delete, last row, full scroll | 1367, 831, 32, 32 (centre 1383, 847) | 1360, 820, 56, 56 | 打开HotCRM助手 |
| 1440×1400 en and zh | Delete, last row, full scroll | 1367, 1331, 32, 32 | 1360, 1320, 56, 56 | the FAB |

The hosted card measured Save's centre at (1365, 849) and Delete's centre at (1383, 847). The harness reproduces both.

**After** (HEAD `50d6a6f8`, en and zh at every viewport):

| Viewport | Save: FAB during edit | Save: hit | Click at Save's centre | FAB after Cancel | Delete at full scroll: FAB | Delete: hit |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| 1440×900 | hidden | 保存 / Save | assistant opened 0 times | visible | hidden | 删除附件 / Delete attachment |
| 1440×1400 | hidden | 保存 / Save | 0 | visible | hidden | 删除附件 / Delete attachment |
| 1280×720 | hidden | Save | 0 | visible | hidden | Delete attachment |
| 1920×1080 | hidden | Save | 0 | visible | hidden | Delete attachment |
| 390×844 | **visible**: the bar (y 787) is below the FAB (y 708 to 764) | Save | 0 | visible | hidden | Delete attachment |

At 390×844 the FAB also hides on the three-row attachments page. That is consistent with the second row's Delete reaching its box at that row pitch (inferred, not separately measured).

**Confirm flow** (1440×900 zh): the dialog read 删除附件 / 确定要删除附件“evidence-3.pdf”吗？ / 取消 / 删除. Cancel sent 0 deletes. Confirm sent exactly one, `sys_attachment` / `att-3`, and two rows were left.

## Pins

- `packages/app-shell/src/layout/__tests__/ConsoleChatbotFab.yieldsCorner-12248.test.tsx` renders the real FAB, the real `InlineEditSaveBar` inside a real `InlineEditProvider`, and the real `RecordAttachmentsPanel`. happy-dom computes no layout, so a `getBoundingClientRect` stub holds the measured geometry. The stub keys on role and accessible label, never on the marker. Each yield case has a control on the same mount: the FAB is shown before the occupant arrives and after it leaves.
- `packages/app-shell/src/views/__tests__/RecordAttachmentsPanel.deleteConfirm-12248.test.tsx` uses the real `ActionConfirmDialog`. It reads strings from the packs by key, in en and zh. Nothing is deleted while the dialog is open, cancel deletes nothing, and confirm deletes once.
- `RecordAttachmentsPanel.test.tsx`: the three delete-path pins now answer the dialog.
- `packages/i18n/src/__tests__/de-quote-pairing-3876.test.ts`: the pinned German pair counts move from 84 to 85, because the new question adds one matched pair.

## Ablation

Each half of the fix was removed at `50d6a6f8` through `ablation-replace.mjs`. In every leg the anchor hit the declared number of times, the blob changed on disk, and the restore was proven: blob equal to HEAD and `git diff HEAD` empty.

1. Drop `data-fab-yield` from the save bar: `yieldsCorner-12248` went 2 failed / 1 passed. The defect pin failed, and so did the positional pin, because the FAB never measured the bar.
2. Drop it from both attachment row actions (2 hits): 1 failed / 2 passed. The row-action pin failed.
3. Make the FAB never yield (`setOccupied(hit);` replaced by `setOccupied(false);`): 2 failed / 1 passed. The positional pin stays green by design.
4. Make the delete skip the question (`const confirmed = await confirmDelete(` prefixed with `true ||`): 7 failed / 28 passed. That is all four `deleteConfirm-12248` pins plus the three delete-path pins in `RecordAttachmentsPanel.test.tsx`.

## Local verification

The gates and tests below ran at HEAD `50d6a6f8` unless a line says otherwise. The commit after `f8ad8a02` touches one i18n test file only.

- **Build:** `turbo run build --filter='@object-ui/app-shell^...' --concurrency=2` passed 28 of 28 tasks (at `f8ad8a02`).
- **Type-check:** `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell --filter @object-ui/plugin-detail --filter @object-ui/i18n run type-check` exited 0, and all three script names were echoed (at `f8ad8a02`). `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json --listFiles` for app-shell and i18n lists the new and edited test files, with 0 errors.
- **Lint:** `eslint .` in the three packages exited 0 with 0 errors. None of the warnings is on a line this PR adds.
- **vitest, narrowed (declared):**
  - At `f8ad8a02`: `packages/app-shell/src/layout/`, the four attachments-panel test files, the objectui#11001 record-delete pin, the objectui#11666 launcher pin, `packages/plugin-detail/src/__tests__/` and `packages/i18n/`. 316 files passed and 1 failed: the de quote count, updated in `50d6a6f8`.
  - At `50d6a6f8`: `packages/i18n/` (83 files, 1321 tests), the seven directly affected files (64 tests) and two pack-reading script tests (15 tests). All passed.
  - The full farm is CI's.
- **Gates,** all exit 0: `check:i18n-keys`, `check:i18n-drift`, `check:i18n-dead-keys` (a report), `check:control-bytes`, `check:new-line-citations` (0 new), `check:vi-mock-inherit`, `check:vi-mock-specifiers`, `check:vi-mock-override-shape`, `check:test-path-roots`, `check:changeset-claims`, `check:pending-changeset-literals`, `check-changeset-no-major`, `check-changeset-presence`.
- **NOT MEASURED:** `check:eager-locale-catalogues`. It reads a built console bundle (PREREQUISITE NOT MET locally, exit 2), so it is left to CI.

Changeset: `.changeset/12248-fab-yields-attachment-confirm.md`. `@object-ui/app-shell` and `@object-ui/plugin-detail` are patch, and `@object-ui/i18n` is minor for the one new pack key.

## Acceptance notes (observed, not filed)

- The console stylesheet's unlayered `button:not([disabled])` rule sets `transition: transform …, filter …`, so it overrides every Tailwind `transition-*` utility on a button. Measured: the FAB's computed `transition-property` is `transform, filter` whatever its class says. That is why the yield is an instant hide rather than a fade. This is polish. Carrier: none.
- The yield is opt-in. No other bottom-right control was measured here. A page whose last content ends in right-aligned buttons would need the marker too. Carrier: none.
